probe_meta.label: dense-G (controlled retrieval-mechanism swap of Probe G)

response_text:
1. (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine of less than 2000 Da and a polyanion, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron, __wherein said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle is formulated for controlled release in an oil and gas reservoir environment__.

2. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle intimately associated with a multivalent cation crosslinker __selected from zirconium acetate, sodium zirconium lactate, zirconium sulfate, zirconium tetrachloride, zirconium orthosulfate, zirconium oxychloride, zirconium carbonate, zirconium ammonium carbonate, and zirconium acetylacetonate__.

3. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyalkylenimine is polyethylenimine __having a molecular weight of 600 to 1800 Da__.

4. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyanion is selected from sodium polyvinyl sulfonate, poly (sodium acrylate), poly(sodium styrene sulfonate), copolymers of sodium acrylate with sodium vinylsulfonate or sodium styrene sulfonate; dextran sulfate, and anionic surfactants, __wherein the polyanion has a molecular weight greater than 10,000 Da__.

5. (Previously presented) The composition of claim 2, wherein said multivalent cation crosslinker is a complexed zirconium compound selected from the group consisting of zirconium acetate, sodium zirconium lactate, zirconium sulfate, zirconium tetrachloride, zirconium orthosulfate, zirconium oxychloride, zirconium carbonate, zirconium ammonium carbonate, zirconium acetylacetonate, aluminum chloride, aluminum sulfate, aluminum citrate, tin chloride, tin sulfate, iron chloride, iron nitrate, titanium chloride, and titanium sulfate.

6. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, further comprising monovalent or divalent cations selected from the group consisting of sodium, potassium, magnesium or calcium ions __in an amount sufficient to maintain nanoparticle stability in field brine__.

8. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex [[comprised]] __comprises__ a nanoparticle with an average particle size of about 100 to 900 nm in diameter __and a zeta potential of -30 to +30 mV__.

9. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticles are stable in water, field brine and seawater __for controlled release applications in oil and gas reservoirs__.

10. (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine __of less than 2000 Da__ and polyvinyl sulfonate (PVS), said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron __and formulated for oil and gas field applications__.

12. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 10, said nanoparticle entrapping a multivalent cation __crosslinker for controlled release in reservoir conditions__.

13. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 12, said multivalent cation comprising Zr, Cr, Ti, Fe or Al __in complexed form__.

21. (Currently Amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a composition of claim 1; b) a polymer [[thai]] __that__ can be crosslinked with a) __wherein the polymer is selected from partially hydrolyzed polyacrylamide, polyacrylic acid, and copolymers thereof__; and c) a fluid.

22. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is an acrylate-based polymer __having anionic functionality for crosslinking__.

23. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is partially hydrolyzed polyacrylamide __with a molecular weight of 1-20 million Da__.

24. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is a polymer or copolymers of acrylate, acrylamide, N,N-dimethyacrylamide, tert-butyl acrylate, acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonic acid, or sodium 2-acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonate, or [[NN, dimethy ac.ylamide]] __N,N-dimethylacrylamide having crosslinkable anionic sites__.

26. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where [[fluid]] __the fluid__ is brine or seawater __having a salinity of 1,000 to 300,000 ppm total dissolved solids__.
